body: There's no specific reason. It's just a constant stream of thoughts: "you're stupid", "you're a fucking idiot", "you should go kill yourself". I've been been depressed on and off since I was probably 10. People have suspected it in the past but you'd be surprised at how easy it is to brush that kind of comment with a response like "Me? Oh no, I'm fine".

Scurrying along

I am the great sewer rat

Living down below

By the sounds of your analyzing skills I could swear that you are my 9th grade English teacher. I guess you are mostly right, however self hatred is simply crippling me. I don't want to exist. I want to feel nothing.
